title: The Future of Airports
author: Elliot Sperber
content:
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/04/image0-1-680x907.jpeg)

Photo: Elliot Sperber.

Troparia - the plural of  
Troparion,  
A hymn  
A short, religious song  
And read reversed its Airaport  
Airport for short  
And what’ll we do with this glut  
Shut  
Down a bunch  
You fly too much  
The new museums look like airports  
Anyhow  
So turn ‘em all, the terminals  
Into museums,  
Housing, gardens, schools  
Each runway a forest, or farm  
Do no harm
